// Removing the fresh local target in Fetch makes this test retain the original flag.
func TestSourceGetSeesExternalLocalUpdate(t *testing.T) {
 ctx := context.Background()
 dir := t.TempDir()
 write := func(key string) {
  t.Helper()
  target, err := ocistore.New(filepath.Join(dir, \"repo\"))
  require.NoError(t, err)
  target.AutoSaveIndex = true
  payload := []byte(\"namespace: other\\nflags:\\n  - key: \" + key + \"\\n    name: \" + key + \"\\n    type: BOOLEAN_FLAG_TYPE\\n\")
  layer := v1.Descriptor{Digest: digest.FromBytes(payload), Size: int64(len(payload)), MediaType: fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptNamespace + \"+yaml\", Annotations: map[string]string{fliptoci.AnnotationFliptNamespace: \"other\"}}
  require.NoError(t, target.Push(ctx, layer, bytes.NewReader(payload)))
  desc, err := oras.PackManifest(ctx, target, oras.PackManifestVersion1_1_RC4, fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptFeatures, oras.PackManifestOptions{ManifestAnnotations: map[string]string{}, Layers: []v1.Descriptor{layer}})
  require.NoError(t, err)
  require.NoError(t, target.Tag(ctx, desc, \"latest\"))
 }
 write(\"first\")
 store, err := fliptoci.NewStore(&config.OCI{BundleDirectory: dir, Repository: \"flipt://local/repo:latest\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 source, err := NewSource(zaptest.NewLogger(t), store)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 first, err := source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = first.GetFlag(ctx, \"other\", \"first\")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 write(\"second\")
 second, err := source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = second.GetFlag(ctx, \"other\", \"second\")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NotSame(t, first, second)
 same, err := source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Same(t, second, same)
}
EOF
go test ./internal/storage/fs/oci"

 layer := v1.Descriptor{Digest: digest.FromBytes(payload), Size: int64(len(payload)), MediaType: fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptFeatures + \"+yaml\"}

// Publishing on every tick would deliver duplicate snapshots; omitting a changed digest would miss updates.
func TestSourceSubscribePublishesOnlyChangedDigest(t *testing.T) {
 ctx := context.Background()
 dir := t.TempDir()
 write := func(key string) {
  t.Helper()
  target, err := ocistore.New(filepath.Join(dir, \"repo\"))
  require.NoError(t, err)
  target.AutoSaveIndex = true
  payload := []byte(\"namespace: default\\nflags:\\n  - key: \" + key + \"\\n    name: \" + key + \"\\n    type: BOOLEAN_FLAG_TYPE\\n\")
  layer := v1.Descriptor{Digest: digest.FromBytes(payload), Size: int64(len(payload)), MediaType: fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptFeatures + \"+yaml\"}
  require.NoError(t, target.Push(ctx, layer, bytes.NewReader(payload)))
  desc, err := oras.PackManifest(ctx, target, oras.PackManifestVersion1_1_RC4, fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptFeatures, oras.PackManifestOptions{ManifestAnnotations: map[string]string{}, Layers: []v1.Descriptor{layer}})
  require.NoError(t, err)
  require.NoError(t, target.Tag(ctx, desc, \"latest\"))
 }
 write(\"first\")
 store, err := fliptoci.NewStore(&config.OCI{BundleDirectory: dir, Repository: \"flipt://local/repo:latest\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 source, err := NewSource(zaptest.NewLogger(t), store, WithPollInterval(20*time.Millisecond))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 subctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
 ch := make(chan *storagefs.StoreSnapshot, 1)
 go source.Subscribe(subctx, ch)
 select {
 case <-ch: t.Fatal(\"unchanged digest was published\")
 case <-time.After(60*time.Millisecond):
 }
 write(\"second\")
 select {
 case snapshot := <-ch:
  _, err := snapshot.GetFlag(ctx, \"default\", \"second\")
  require.NoError(t, err)
 case <-time.After(time.Second): t.Fatal(\"changed digest was not published\")
 }
 select {
 case <-ch: t.Fatal(\"same digest published twice\")
 case <-time.After(60*time.Millisecond):
 }
 cancel()
 select {
 case _, open := <-ch: require.False(t, open)
 case <-time.After(time.Second): t.Fatal(\"subscription did not stop\")
 }
}
EOF
